name: HotLiveRtcStream

parameters.help_en: The application name of the live stream to prefetch
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the live stream to prefetch
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The prefetch area. For more information, see the RegionCode lookup table.

For regions within China, specify the corresponding code from the "Region codes for China" table. For all other regions, specify the country code.

If the CodeRegionHasNoNode error is returned after you specify a RegionCode, the corresponding area is not covered by L1 nodes and cannot be prefetched. In this case, specify a different RegionCode
parameters.help_zh:
预热区域，详细内容请查看RegionCode对应简码表格。

预热区域粒度海外是国家简码，中国或中国内地是各省简码。
如果传入某个RegionCode后返回CodeRegionHasNoNode，说明对应区域没有L1节点覆盖，无法预热，可以更换RegionCode
parameters.name: region_code

parameters.help_en: The duration to maintain the prefetch connection. Unit: milliseconds. The default value, 0, means the connection is always maintained
parameters.help_zh: 预热链接保持的时间，单位毫秒。默认0是一直保持
parameters.name: connection_timeout

parameters.help_en: The custom timeout period for a timeout event. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 自定义超时事件的触发时间。单位毫秒
parameters.name: media_timeout
